thread:
emily: Heads up — INV-2026-06-214 (DeltaInc) totals don't match export vs PDF. PDF shows a much smaller usage line. batch=billing-run-20260630-03

josh: Oof. Which field is different? Can you paste the two line sets?

emily: Exported lines:
```json
[{"code":"subscription","amount":"300.00"},{"code":"usage_tokens","qty":"100000","rate":"0.00001","amount":"1000.00"}]
```

emily: PDF-rendered lines:
```json
[{"code":"subscription","amount":"300.00"},{"code":"usage_tokens","qty":"10000","rate":"0.00001","amount":"100.00"}]
```

invoices-bot: job=billing-run-20260630-03 step=render note=qty_mismatch detected for invoice=INV-2026-06-214. auto-send=blocked.

priya: Looks like a units conversion bug — maybe tokens vs tens-of-thousands. Could be in the usage-aggregation worker or the PDF template.

josh: Also check PR #2670 (quota-compress) — it introduced a divide-by-10 in one helper. If that's the regression, we need a hotfix.

emily: For remediation: 1) set invoice hold (don't send/pay), 2) generate corrected invoice INV-2026-06-214-v2 with qty=100000 and amount=1000.00, 3) reconcile accounting export to remove the wrong PDF entry if it bubbled into drafts. Agreed?

priya: Agreed. I'll create the reissue and open incident INC-2026-06-BILL-19 assigned to eng-billing + eng-usage. Notes: "unit conversion/aggregation bug causing PDF rendering to show qty/amount*0.1"

emily: I set hold: `/billing set-flag INV-2026-06-214 hold-for-review --reason "qty mismatch PDF vs export"`

invoices-bot: Flag set on INV-2026-06-214: hold-for-review.

priya: Reissue created INV-2026-06-214-v2. Includes corrected usage line qty=100000 amount=1000.00. Marking original as replaced and adding note referencing INC-2026-06-BILL-19.

josh: I'll review PR #2670 and prepare a rollback/hotfix. Adding a unit test that asserts consistent qty across export -> invoice_view -> pdf.

emily: Customer notified by acct-team: "We found a formatting issue with your draft invoice. We're issuing a corrected invoice and no payment was captured"

priya: Closing loop once hotfix merged and accounting draft export is reconciled. Will update this thread. :thumbsup:
